description: The source is a flat mauve 0x8060a0 -- three channels, all mid-range and all different -- so every knob moves it visibly and none of them moves it by accident. Contrast at 2.0 doubles the distance of every channel from mid-grey: red barely moves because it is already there, green falls a long way, blue rises. A build pivoting about black rather than mid-grey would simply double all three, which is a different picture and a brighter one.
